findings.title: WordPress Core RCE (CVE-2026-119977)
findings.summary: Predictable staging paths used during core upgrades allow unauthenticated remote code execution.

findings.title: GitLab RCE (CVE-2026-97229)
findings.summary: An integer overflow in regular expression validation allows unauthenticated remote code execution on GitLab servers.

findings.title: SonicWall SonicOS SSL-VPN MFA Bypass
findings.summary: An authentication enforcement flaw allows attackers with valid credentials to bypass SAML and multi-factor authentication.

findings.title: OpenSSH 'SSHole' Auth Bypass (CVE-2026-123158)
findings.summary: A password authentication bypass exists in OpenSSH when used with musl libc without PAM.

findings.title: Barracuda ESG/ADC Root Access Chain
findings.affected_technology: Barracuda Email Security Gateway / Load Balancer ADC
findings.summary: A combination of authentication bypass and command injection allows unauthenticated attackers to gain root access.

findings.title: Microsoft Paint RCE (CVE-2026-83844)
findings.summary: An out-of-bounds read vulnerability in Windows Paint could allow a remote unauthorized attacker to execute arbitrary code.
